title.en: Season 1 finale: you can do it, and you can choose not to
title.zh-Hans: 第一季结课：你能完成，也能选择不做

timing_note: Line and word timings are aligned to measured narration wavs (episodes/narration-timing.json); words are spread proportionally within each measured line. On-screen zh-Hans captions follow the English narration timing.

narration.command_template: python -m mlx_audio.tts.generate --model mlx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base-8bit --lang_code en --ref_audio /Volumes/致态2TB/nx-agents/education/v2/voice-en-master-reference.wav --ref_text "Your KYC got rejected again? Don't worry. Most rejections come down to just a few simple mistakes. Let's fix them together." --text "<line>" --output_path <dir> --file_prefix <name>
narration.english_voice_instruct: a cheerful young American woman in her twenties, warm and energetic, clear diction, friendly YouTube tutorial host
narration.sam_voice_design_instruct: a friendly adult American man new to crypto, natural and conversational, clear diction, curious but not cartoonish
narration.sam_voice_note: Task-specific brief requests Sam lines with this distinct VoiceDesign model; this overrides the older global owner note that male voice was not used.

open_visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S1 · E12' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
open_visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第1季 · 第12集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。

shots.visual_en: Sam faces two doors, 'Start real trading' and 'Finish practice first', and picks the second.
shots.visual_zh: 小白面对“开始真实交易”和“先完成练习”两个入口，选择后者。

text.en: I've watched eleven episodes. Should I deposit now?
text.zh-Hans: 我看了十一集，是不是现在就该充值？

shots.source_visual_zh: 小白面对“开始真实交易”和“先完成练习”两个入口，选择后者。

shots.visual_en: Nexubo opens a task sheet: identity and region confirmed; every balance labelled VIRTUAL.
shots.visual_zh: 小纳打开一张任务单：身份与地区已确认，所有余额均标为虚拟。

text.en: Learning how doesn't mean you have to invest. Today, with practice money only, we'll run one flow: check the entry and eligibility, find spot, confirm the amount and fee, then check the trade record.
text.zh-Hans: 学会操作，不代表必须投资。今天只用模拟资金完成一条流程：核对入口和资格，找到现货，确认金额与费用，再查看成交记录。

shots.source_visual_zh: 小纳打开一张任务单：身份与地区已确认，所有余额均标为虚拟。

shots.visual_en: After the practice buy, the price drops; the checklist still gets ticks. No profit medal.
shots.visual_zh: 模拟买入后价格下跌，系统仍给操作核对项打勾，不发利润奖章。
shots.onscreen_text_zh-Hans: 价格跌了，检查照样合格

text.en: Even if the price falls in practice, you can still do everything right. We score whether you checked and understood, not whether you happened to pick a rise.
text.zh-Hans: 练习里即使价格下跌，你也可能把操作做对。我们评分看的是是否核对、是否理解，而不是你碰巧选中了上涨。

shots.source_visual_zh: 模拟买入后价格下跌，系统仍给操作核对项打勾，不发利润奖章。

shots.visual_en: Then a partial sell; a task pops up: 'Send to a friend who only supports a different network.' Sam refuses to send. Antenna red + ding, then green.
shots.visual_zh: 接着卖出一部分；弹出“转给只支持另一网络的朋友”任务，小白拒绝发送。

text.en: Something's wrong with this transfer. I'm not sending it.
text.zh-Hans: 这条转账信息有问题，我不转。

text.en: That's a correct answer too. When the network, fees or identity aren't clear, stopping matters more than forcing the task through.
text.zh-Hans: 这也是正确答案。遇到不确定的网络、费用或身份信息，停下比强行完成任务更重要。

shots.source_visual_zh: 接着卖出一部分；弹出“转给只支持另一网络的朋友”任务，小白拒绝发送。

shots.visual_en: Learner summary: selling ≠ withdrawing; on-chain confirmation ≠ platform credit; never share credentials.
shots.visual_zh: 学员总结：卖出不等于提现；链上确认不等于平台入账；凭证不外传。

text.en: Finally, say three things back. Where did the asset go? How much was actually taken? Who controls your account? If you can't explain one, go back to that episode and practise again.
text.zh-Hans: 最后复述三个判断：资产去了哪里，钱实际扣了多少，以及谁能控制你的账户。说不清楚的部分，就回到对应课程再练一次。

label.zh-Hans: 链上确认 ≠ 平台入账

shots.source_visual_zh: 学员总结：卖出不等于提现；链上确认不等于平台入账；凭证不外传。

zh-Hans: 链上确认 ≠ 平台入账

shots.visual_en: Completion card: 'Basic practice complete', with 'Review safety' and 'Learn trading rules' beside it.
shots.visual_zh: 结课卡写“完成基础操作练习”，旁边“复习安全”和“了解交易规则”。

text.en: What you've earned is a learning record, not a licence to invest. Keep learning, or don't trade for now. Both are fine. Understand first, then act.
text.zh-Hans: 你获得的是学习记录，不是投资资格。继续学习可以，暂时不交易也可以。先看懂，再动手。

shots.source_visual_zh: 结课卡写“完成基础操作练习”，旁边“复习安全”和“了解交易规则”。

conversion_card.visual_en: Conversion card (8 s): clean NexuAlpha card slides in from the right; text only (exchange name as text, no exchange logo artwork, no fake clickable button, no QR to an unverified page). Disclosure line sits on the card itself, at least 70% of subtitle size. No reward amount, no percentage, no date. Nexubo beside the card, thumbs-up, antenna green. For restricted locales swap to the restricted_variant (official-site link only).
conversion_card.visual_zh: 转化卡（8秒）：NexuAlpha卡片从右侧滑入；只用文字写交易所名称，不放交易所标志图，不画假按钮，不放未核验二维码。披露语印在卡片上，字号不小于字幕的70%。不出现奖励金额、百分比和日期。小纳在旁点赞，天线绿灯。受限语种改用 restricted_variant（只给官网链接）。

end_hook.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
end_hook.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

close_visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
close_visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。

goal.zh-Hans: 独立完成模拟现货与转账判断，并把操作正确和盈利分开。

page_cta.line_en: Season 1 done. Compare OKX, Bitget and Binance on NexuAlpha, then register through an official partner link. Or keep practising. Join our Telegram for Season 2.
page_cta.line_zh: 第一季完成。在 NexuAlpha 对比 OKX、Bitget、Binance，再通过官方合作链接注册；也可以继续练习。加入 Telegram 追第二季。

exercise.task_en: Complete, in order: a practice buy and sell, a fee check, rejecting a wrong-network transfer and spotting a scam. Key questions must all be correct.
exercise.task_zh: 依次完成模拟买卖、费用核对、错误网络拒绝和诈骗识别；关键题必须全对。
exercise.answer_en: You pass by following the correct flow or by actively stopping an unsuitable action. Profit is not scored.
exercise.answer_zh: 按正确流程完成或主动停止不合适操作均可过关；不按盈利评分。

The conversion card comes after 'not trading is fine', and never contradicts it ｜ 转化卡放在“暂时不交易也可以”之后，不得与之矛盾
